description: Header file defining a warp iterator class for loading tiles of GEMM operands from shared memory in CUDA, specifically for use with NVIDIA Tensor Cores. It includes class templates, methods for iterating and loading data, and detailed CUDA-specific logic.

classes.name: WarpIteratorFromSmem
classes.description: A CUDA warp-level iterator class for loading tiles of GEMM operands from shared memory, supporting transposition and specific instruction shapes.

methods.name: WarpIteratorFromSmem
methods.description: Constructor initializing the iterator with a tensor reference and lane ID, setting up the origin and offsets based on CUDA warp lane.

methods.name: add_tile_offset
methods.description: Advances the iterator by a specified tile offset in the tensor.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next tile along the operand dimension.

methods.name: operator++
methods.description: Increments the iterator to the next position within the current tile, or advances to the next tile if current is exhausted.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a fragment of data from shared memory into a register fragment, using CUDA ldsm for efficient shared memory access.
